### Milestone 4 Implementation Summary: Catalog Discovery, Search & Content Details Integration

Milestone 4 has been implemented, validated, and verified with **100% test pass rates and zero regressions**.

### Key Deliverables Implemented & Verified

1. **TMDB API v3 & Wing Lists Client (`app/js/tmdb.js`)**:
   - Endpoints implemented: `getTrending`, `getTopRated`, `discover`, `getGenres`, `getDetails`, `getTvSeason`, `searchMulti`, and `getCuratedLists`.
   - In-memory LRU/TTL cache capped at 100 entries (enforcing webOS TV 1.5GB RAM safety).
   - 8000ms `AbortController` timeout for all fetch queries.
   - Vector SVG data URI fallbacks (`getFallbackPosterSvg`, `getFallbackStillSvg`, `getFallbackProfileSvg`) preventing 404 retry loops.
   - Deterministic offline mock dataset for network-independent CI/test execution.

2. **10-Foot TV View Controllers (`app/js/views/`)**:
   - **`views/home.js` (`HomeViewController`)**: Top featured title binding into the 600px Hero Banner; 5 dynamic shelf rails (`#shelf-trending-movies`, `#shelf-trending-series`, `#shelf-toprated`, `#shelf-toprated-tv`, `#shelf-curated`) using `DocumentFragment` with a 20-item memory-safety ceiling; shared `CardFactory` (`createPosterCard`, `createEpisodeCard`, `createCastCard`).
   - **`views/catalog.js` (`CatalogViewController`)**: Powers `MoviesViewController` and `SeriesViewController` with dynamic genre filter pills, sort order toggle, release year filter, 6-column 2D grid layout, and infinite scroll / pagination.
   - **`views/search.js` (`SearchViewController`)**: Full 38-key on-screen TV virtual keyboard; modal focus trapping via `SpatialNav.trap`; 300ms debounced live multi-search; search result counts and empty/error query states.
   - **`views/details.js` (`DetailsViewController`)**: Backdrop and metadata binding; 12-slot cast carousel; TV show season selector tabs; 16:9 aspect ratio (320x180px) episode still cards; "More Like This" recommendations rail; seamless player launch dispatching.

3. **Application Shell & DOM Integration (`app/js/app.js` & `app/index.html`)**:
   - Wired `switchView` hooks to activate modular view controllers.
